description.value: Boba Boy is a bubble tea chain with locations across BC, Ontario, and the US, operated by Tea Shop 168 Group Inc. The South Surrey location sits in a strip unit on Highway 10 and distinguishes itself by producing tapioca in-store from fresh ingredients rather than using pre-manufactured pearls. Cyclists on the Highway 10 corridor can stop in for made-to-order boba drinks and place orders online for pickup.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: wave (3 spaces, covered) at 51m; rack (2 spaces) at 72m; rack (5 spaces) at 92m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's locations page explicitly lists the South Surrey location at '#104-15127 Hwy 10 Surrey, BC, V3S 9A5' with phone '(778) 574-5678', corroborating both OSM fields. The site confirms the business is an active bubble tea cafe chain with online ordering and delivery available, but provides no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-relevant amenities. Takeout is inferred from the explicit mention of online ordering and delivery availability at most locations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active bubble tea cafe with a confirmed address and phone on the brand website; a useful refreshment stop for cyclists on the Highway 10 corridor.
